title: Continuation label for a prefix scan
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $m$ be one of the four code modes (valid, initial, accepting, or step-pair), let $p\in\{0,1,2\}$, and let $k\in\{0,1,2,3\}$. For $k=0$ or $1$, the label tests position $p$ with Boolean parameter false or true, respectively; for $k=2$, it scans at position $p$. For $k=3$, it selects the copy label for $A$ when $p=0$, the copy label for $B$ when $p=1$ and $m$ is the step-pair mode, the copy label for $Q1s$ when $p=1$ in any other mode or when $p=2$.
